title: Metis
tagline: A personal assistant, from conversation to a clearer day.
description: Native iPhone and web interfaces bring together reminders, daily priorities, memory and plans from conversations. Calendar proposals stay reviewable, and Apple Health integration connects the native app to the assistant.
features: Daily workspace, reminders and calendar proposals
Native iOS companion with HealthKit integration
Persistent memory and controlled background tasks

title: SheetParcel
tagline: Spreadsheets in. Customer-ready PDFs out.
description: An offline browser tool that imports Excel or CSV price lists, applies customer-specific discounts and exports branded PDFs in a ZIP. Processing happens locally, with a public demo for trying the workflow.
features: Export branded PDFs without an account

title: Mnemosyne
tagline: A living memory for a long-running roleplay campaign.
description: A Discord companion for The Long Way Home: it archives roleplay, retrieves source-grounded context, supports daily reviews and maintains railway displays. Public information and private DM material remain separate.

title: Contractstudio
tagline: Maintenance contracts, assembled with care.
description: A guided web workspace for drafting Xylem maintenance contracts. Customer, scope and pricing steps feed a paginated preview and a branded PDF, with conditional clauses for different maintenance requirements.
features: Guided customer, maintenance and pricing steps
Live document preview and PDF export

title: Zagreus · Local AI
tagline: A small, private AI workspace on modest hardware.
description: A self-hosted personal workspace with local model inference, chat history, memory review, evaluations and a Today view. Reviewed corrections can inform a separate preference-ranking model, with explicit promotion and rollback.
features: Reviewed feedback and controlled model changes

title: Night Shift
tagline: An idle game about an office that gets stranger.
description: A minimalist browser game that starts at one occupied desk and branches into Order, Control or Irregularity. Each route changes the mechanics, events and long-term progression, with local saves and offline progress.

title: Expedition Ledger
tagline: Keep the party moving, and the supplies honest.
description: A browser dashboard for a tabletop expedition. It tracks remaining distance, rations and backpack capacity, and applies the different costs and distances of normal and haste travel.
features: Travel actions with explicit ration costs

title: Pico OLED Companion
tagline: A tiny display with a useful sense of time.
description: A Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W display project for Codex allowance telemetry and solar information. The MicroPython firmware combines Wi-Fi fetching, OLED layouts, a setup portal and recovery tooling.
features: Local setup and USB recovery tools
capture: Firmware-rendered preview · not a device photograph

title: Xylem Kortingsregeling
tagline: From a customer number to a consistent discount document.
description: A Windows application that reads an approved customer export and discount template, then produces a customer PDF, Excel copy and audit record. It validates daily data refreshes and handles ambiguous customer matches explicitly.
features: Validated customer lookup and scheme selection

title: XBNL KPI Dashboard
tagline: One place to explore business performance.
description: A business dashboard organized around 28 KPI definitions across ten sections. Its service view is built for read-only maintenance-report retrieval, with status counts, completion context and source-refresh information. The portfolio captures use an isolated, unconnected instance.
features: Ten business sections with metric definitions
Service maintenance status and completion views
Explicit source connection and refresh status
capture: Application capture · disconnected source, example owner labels

title: Hermes
tagline: A meeting assistant made for a Raspberry Pi.
description: A compact recording workflow with a touchscreen-oriented interface. Hermes transcribes audio, produces summaries and can deliver recaps to Discord, with visible processing progress and temporary-file cleanup.

title: Charon
tagline: Structured memory for the Pantheon ecosystem.
description: A focused archival service that stores records, applies a retention gate and retrieves relevant material with identifiers and confidence information. PostgreSQL, vector search and raw object storage support durable recall.

title: Ananke
tagline: Turn accumulated signals into explicit forecasts.
description: An experimental forecasting service that extracts structured features from events and models project risk, workload and routine trends. Forecasts carry a horizon, contributing factors and scenario information; this is a software experiment, not a validated clinical model.

title: Athena
tagline: Translate forecasts into a bounded weekly plan.
description: The strategy layer of Pantheon. Athena takes Ananke forecast snapshots and creates a limited weekly intervention plan, preserving plan history and optionally storing readable plans in Charon.

title: Hypnos
tagline: Bring sleep records into structured memory.
description: A sleep-data ingestion tool that normalizes sessions from configurable providers, including SleepCloud, and passes records to Charon. Deduplication and stored state help avoid importing the same session repeatedly.

title: Helios
tagline: A status board for a family of services.
description: A FastAPI and HTMX dashboard that receives service heartbeats and displays health states. It gives the Pantheon ecosystem a common place to inspect online, offline and degraded services.

title: Clio
tagline: A readable record of a day's development.
description: A small tool that gathers GitHub activity for a date and turns it into a Markdown report. It separates provider access, configuration and report generation so a daily development summary is easy to produce.

title: Prometheus
tagline: A toolkit for the people behind the story.
description: A self-hosted Discord bot for managing NPCs, locations and loose plot hooks. Slash commands and a lightweight dashboard help a game master organize narrative information stored in local JSON files.

title: Pantheon Mobile
tagline: An Android control surface for your bots.
description: A native Android app with an all-bots overview and individual service tabs. It polls status endpoints and exposes configurable actions, with confirmation dialogs and response previews.

title: Pantheon Core
tagline: Shared foundations for independent services.
description: A small Python package that centralizes the common pieces used by Pantheon bots: heartbeat integration, configuration loading, logging and shared status types.

title: Face Locker
tagline: Computer vision meets a physical access system.
description: A face-recognition module for the DaVinci smart locker project. It combines camera input, facial encodings, user management and locker control with a Python desktop interface.

title: Exchange Grid Autopilot
tagline: A stateful grid-trading experiment.
description: An automated trading prototype with a paper mode, persistent positions and configurable exposure limits. It implements a mean-reversion grid and records events in SQLite. No performance or profitability claims are made.

title: Discord AI Bot Template
tagline: A minimal starting point for a conversational bot.
description: A compact Python template that responds to Discord mentions and keeps the last ten messages per channel as short-term context. It is a starting point for further bot development.

title: Zagreus · Discord
tagline: An early personal assistant, built around Discord.
description: The earlier Zagreus agent connects a conversational core to calendar, weather and Discord adapters. A separate heartbeat integration reports service lifecycle and health to Helios.

title: Metis Public Site
tagline: A clear introduction to a private assistant.
description: A compact public site explaining how Metis turns plans from conversations into reviewable appointments. It also provides the project's privacy information and contact route.

title: Network Configuration Automation
tagline: Repeatable configuration across an equipment list.
description: A Python automation tool for a device-management workflow. It reads an equipment list, checks prerequisites, applies configuration steps and records per-device outcomes in Excel.

title: Modbus Configuration Uploader
tagline: Batch configuration with a traceable result.
description: A device-configuration utility that reuses an authenticated browser session to upload a CSV configuration and apply it. Results are recorded in CSV and, when configured, in the source tracking workbook.

title: Advantech Firmware Updater
tagline: Make repeated firmware maintenance manageable.
description: A Python maintenance utility for processing a list of industrial routers, navigating their management interface and recording firmware-update outcomes. It is presented without device addresses or credentials.

title: Advantech Reboot Tool
tagline: A repeatable maintenance workflow for router fleets.
description: A batch utility that reads devices from Excel or CSV, handles management-interface login and performs a reboot workflow with time limits and per-device results.

title: Equipment List Reconciler
tagline: Compare equipment lists in a desktop workspace.
description: A PySide6 desktop tool for working with equipment spreadsheets. It uses configurable keys, including IP-address columns, and a table-based interface for reviewing and reconciling records.

title: This Portfolio
tagline: The project index you're looking at.
description: A static portfolio collecting software, hardware and automation projects in one searchable gallery. Project descriptions, technology notes and clearly labelled captures are published independently of private application source code.
